name: MZ ETZ 250 / TS 250
engine: 143 or 243 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, premix or oil injection, enclosed chain
intro: The East German MZ two-strokes. Simple, tough, with fully enclosed chains and oil injection on some ETZs.

B: Some ETZs have oil injection and others run premix. Check yours before you fill it.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
